description:
A single ambient environment reading from the DHT11 sensor.

DHT11 IMPORTANT: This sensor measures *ambient air* temperature and
humidity at the sensor mounting location.  It does NOT measure:
- Motor winding temperature
- Motor housing / case temperature
- Bearing temperature

Field names use the ``ambient_`` prefix to make this distinction
explicit.  Do not rename these fields to ``motor_temperature`` or
similar.

DHT11 typical characteristics:
- Temperature accuracy: ±2 °C
- Humidity accuracy: ±5 % RH
- Minimum sampling interval: ~1 s (recommended 2 s)
- NOT suitable for high-frequency sampling; do not model at 200 Hz.

ambient_humidity_pct.description: Ambient relative humidity in percent (0–100 inclusive) as measured by the DHT11.
ambient_humidity_pct.title: Ambient Humidity Pct

ambient_temperature_c.description: Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius as measured by the DHT11.  This is NOT motor winding or housing temperature.
ambient_temperature_c.title: Ambient Temperature C

run_id.description: Run identifier this sample belongs to.
run_id.title: Run Id

timestamp_us.description: Microseconds elapsed since the start of the acquisition run.
timestamp_us.title: Timestamp Us
